verdict.rationale: Vesting schedules are a fair question for an employee-share platform like Vestd, so the axis applies. The evidence covers setting up and granting EMI, CSOP and unapproved option schemes and processing exercise requests. None of it mentions custom vesting schedules, cliffs, milestone vesting, exit acceleration, or automatic vested-versus-unvested tracking, and option granting alone is an adjacent capability that earns no credit.
